WITH line_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    invoice_number,
    CASE 
      WHEN derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL 
        AND derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL 
        AND derived_total_cost <> 0
      THEN derived_product_cost / derived_total_cost 
      ELSE NULL 
    END AS line_cost_ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
),
invoice_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    invoice_number,
    COUNT(*) AS line_item_count,
    AVG(line_cost_ratio) AS invoice_cost_ratio
  FROM line_ratios
  GROUP BY invoice_number
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(invoice_cost_ratio) AS avg_cost_ratio
  FROM invoice_stats
  WHERE invoice_cost_ratio IS NOT NULL
),
with_relative_ratio AS (
  SELECT 
    i.invoice_number,
    i.invoice_cost_ratio,
    i.line_item_count,
    CASE 
      WHEN oa.avg_cost_ratio <> 0 
      THEN i.invoice_cost_ratio / oa.avg_cost_ratio 
      ELSE NULL 
    END AS relative_ratio
  FROM invoice_stats i
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
  WHERE oa.avg_cost_ratio IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  invoice_number,
  invoice_cost_ratio,
  line_item_count,
  relative_ratio
FROM with_relative_ratio
ORDER BY 
  CASE WHEN relative_ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  relative_ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
